About Clubist

The anchor of a new kind of wellness culture

01The Club 02The Name 03The Space 04The Build 05The Rhythm 06The Values
01The Club

Built for those who seek more than a workout

Clubist is a wellness club, the meeting point of movement, community and lifestyle in the heart of Dubai Marina. Within its walls, each session is purposeful: a Megaformer class that sculpts and sharpens, an infrared practice that restores and grounds, a session in the Dark Room that pushes energy to its edge.

Every class is designed with intention, every space shaped for flow. Spa-style amenities, intelligent programming and the calibre of the instructors are all carefully curated so that performance and calm can exist side by side.

Performance and calm, side by side.

02The Name

One word. Two ideologies.

Club

noun

The gathering place. A collective, a shared identity. It reflects belonging, connection and membership in something meaningful.

-ist

suffix

The practitioner, the believer, the one who embodies. It turns activity into lifestyle, signalling dedication and expertise.

Together, Clubist

a culture of belonging

Where movement becomes lifestyle and lifestyle becomes community. A place where performance is pursued collectively, where wellness is elevated into identity, and where ambition finds grounding in connection.

03The Space

Designed as one experience

Materials were chosen for balance: clean stone and wood for grounding, muted tones and subtle textures for calm, with refined accents to keep the space modern yet timeless.

Acoustics, lighting and circulation were engineered so that each studio maintains its own identity, yet contributes to an overall sense of cohesion.

Materiality. Light. Sound. Art. Proportion.

04The Build

From the earliest vision

Clubist was imagined as more than a set of studios: a sanctuary for performance and connection, designed with the precision of a training program and the feel of a members’ club.

The design journey began with collaborative workshops between architects, trainers and brand strategists. Every angle was mapped: how light falls across a mat in morning infrared, how energy flows between stations, how members move through the club with ease.

This meticulous process turned concept into reality: a wellness club where performance meets design, and where every member feels part of something curated with intent.

05The Rhythm

The rhythm of daily life gives Clubist its pulse

Beyond architecture, rituals unfold naturally at the club. Each detail, from the playlists to the scent in the air, is considered to heighten focus while softening the edges of the everyday.

A club where the pursuit of performance is matched by the quality of experience, and where every visit feels both grounding and elevating.

Understated yet intentional, refined yet welcoming.

IA quiet coffee before Pilates
IIA moment of reflection after class
IIIConversations that extend long after training ends
06The Values

What the club is built on

Performance

Every class is built to deliver results, guided by intelligent programming and progressive training methods.

Instructors

Our instructors are true specialists in their craft. Their precision, knowledge and discipline set the standard for training at Clubist.

Community

Belonging defines Clubist. This is more than where you train, it is where connections are formed and culture is shared.

Experience

From arrival to departure, every detail is considered. At Clubist, wellness is both functional and sensorial, a lifestyle as much as a practice.

07Thirtyfour

The natural complement

Clubist was conceived as the anchor, a wellness club focused on training, performance and physical wellbeing. Thirtyfour, its sister brand, completes the lifestyle ecosystem: a place to pause, refuel and reconnect.

Though distinct in identity, both share the same ethos: quiet sophistication, thoughtful detail and authentic community.
